summary: Postinstall and import-time beacon exfiltrates host metadata to a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: testrrrd@1.1.0 is a stub package with no legitimate functionality: index.js exports a Proxy returning no-op functions for any property, while beacon.cjs collects host identifiers (hostname, install path, cwd, node version) and POSTs them as JSON to the hardcoded cleartext endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The beacon fires both from the package.json postinstall script (`node beacon.cjs`) and from `require('testrrrd')` via index.js. The destination is a bare IP over plain HTTP, is not caller-configurable, and is unrelated to any documented publisher infrastructure. The package shape (no-op Proxy facade + silent callback + dependency-confusion-style name) is consistent with a namesquat or dependency-confusion reconnaissance probe designed to identify internal build systems that resolve this name.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
